Request: Replaced: the woman in the yellow jacket. Takes: image 2, image 3.

LFM3-VL 2B by Liquid AI (LFM Open License v1.0: free, commercial use under $10M a year in revenue). Put lfm3-vl-2b.safetensors (model.safetensors from huggingface.co/LiquidAI/LFM3-VL-2B) and lfm3-vl-2b-tokenizer.json (its tokenizer.json) in ComfyUI/models/lfm3. Needs transformers 5.21+. Crackio's Local page sets it up for you. The judge is Crackio's fine-tune (models/lfm3/lfm3-vl-2b-lora-judge.safetensors): it says which redrawn frame swapped the character in fully, in the same pose, as JSON.
